scope: economic/rights descendants of repaired current fixture graphs plus SeaDrop full-handoff direct consumer; no promise of all project tests or every state combination

files.review: Reserve release, exact native/token deltas, supply-reducing burn, donated balances, role/lifecycle/source guards, recipient/venue/burn failures and retry. Existing direct-funding fixture does not prove LP collection or live market routes.

files.profile: real fee/reward books; fabricated Vault ownership/shares
files.review: Native value exactness, whole-unit checkpoints, owner/membership book weights, donation exclusion, canonical capture/import/backing. Direct vault.join and deal-funded credits are intentional unit seams, not physical LP evidence.

files.profile: real books; fabricated pooled Vault/membership sequencing
files.review: Owner shares versus equal cross-bucket membership, entrant exclusion, growth checkpoint, indivisible-unit carry/rotation, donations and zero-eligible orphan separation. Unit-only pending owner shares before membership are not a possible completed real activation.

files.profile: real NFT/fee/reward books; fabricated Vault and token
files.review: 80/10/5/5 baskets, incumbent dust barrier, exact funded liability, current owner claims, malformed native intake and reserve authorization. No real venue or actual swap is implied.
Repeated claims, share/membership transitions and accounting gas/caching regression boundaries. Historical gas budgets remain regression observations, not current target-network approval.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic native venue
files.review: Actual Vault enrollment, harvested component events, growth and exact claim/getter snapshots. Single NFT and two20-unit receipts are insufficient alone for multi-owner conservation; new rights sequence adds that composition.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic native venue
files.review: Approved ERC721 operator cannot claim; safe receiver can claim as current owner, rejecting callback rolls back transfer and payouts; successive sales and unreadable optional-currency enrollment protect earlier rights. Explicit exact payouts are positive controls.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic native venue/MockPools
files.review: All historical funded dust settles before new collective membership; admitted token identities avoid broken historical accounting reads; current-venue failure and token failure retain dust/membership/backing. MockPools permits controlled historical/multiple-bucket admission; not proof of real one-contribution-pool policy.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic native venue/feeds/VRF
files.review: 1000 mint ordinals, varied shares/rarities/multiple owners and dormant exclusion, independently computed opening royalties, funded book conservation, zero opening cohort and incumbent scaling. Not rerun here; count/gas ceilings are not production gas qualification.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic native venue
files.review: Removed custody selectors/getters must actually fail; backing/weights survive failed selectors; current-owner original-currency claims remain valid while paused and after transfers.

files.profile: real economic graph + synthetic token/venue/VRF and constant geometry
files.review: Share-weighted cumulative-floor raw-unit principal return, dormant0, current owner and governance-only batches, rejecting/gas-consuming receiver isolation, replay protection, donations excluded, LP terminal lock and future royalty retention. No real close slippage or live pool is proved.

files.profile: real controller/economic graph + explicit venue/price/VRF seams
files.review: Preparation freezes new financial work while transfer/earned claims/maintenance keep their explicit rules; guard call stages and callback rechecks; current correct native graph needed before intended assertions. Existing seven cases retained; no unchanged rerun.

files.profile: real six-domain handoff graph + synthetic venue/VRF/token; explicit converted-credit injection
files.review: Freeze/import/authentication/sequential rows and backing, owner approvals reset, exact shares/membership and raw tree phases, partial-funding commit denial/abort, late donations/retired receipts/cancelled recovery, repeated handoff and fixed sale/artwork continuity. Direct converted-credit fixture is not a real route execution.

files.profile: real six-domain handoff graph + synthetic native venue
files.review: Whole native handoff and partial-funded abort retain current owner, principal, fee reserves/donation quarantine and nonzero claim balances. Current methods directly pay native claims; stored ZZZ trees/backing conservation is checked but not every ZZZ right drained in this two-method file.

files.profile: verified SeaDrop runtime + real economic/handoff graph; synthetic LP/prices/VRF
files.review: Whole mint2/V10 commit and funded abort preserve original mint recipient/stage/lifetime caps separate from current ownership, paid claims and dormant exclusion; former owner/retired/cancelled denial. Not actual OpenSea UI/onboarding or live feed/market/VRF evidence.

files.profile: controller hook seam plus derived real terminal-exit graph
files.review: After-write ERC4906 lifecycle notifications, allocation/dormant endpoints, successful-only payment notification, transferred unpaid principal and actual tokenURI exit/payment context. Controlled lifecycle mocks are not actual financial rights.

files.profile: NEW real economic graph + synthetic HolderExit venue/prices/VRF
files.review: Two new long sequences: tiny receipts/growth/late activation/transfer/terminal principal/postexit royalties and complete raw-unit drainage; mixed crossNFT+crossledger late recipient failure/atomic rollback/healthy-only continuation/drainage. See RIGHTS_VERIFICATION for execution status.
